name: crucible
description: Crucible — a distilled 1v1 browser RTS. Easy to learn, brutal to master.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npx tsx shared/src/sim/sim.test.ts && npx tsx shared/src/sim/ai.test.ts
